result.summary: The image depicts a residential street with continuous sidewalks and a marked zebra crosswalk. While basic infrastructure like curb ramps is present, the crossing lacks active traffic control or signage, and parked vehicles may obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars on the right side of the street are very close to the crosswalk, potentially blocking the view of pedestrians for oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway near the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control
hazards.description: There are no visible stop signs or signals at this crossing to regulate vehicle flow and prioritize pedestrians.

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Debris and cracking are visible near the curb ramp, which could pose a tripping hazard or impede mobility devices.
hazards.location_in_image: Bottom left corner near the curb.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20 feet of the crosswalk to improve sightlines for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and physically prevent parking too close to the intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
